_doc: Hand-assigned primary kind per paragraph, as [firstLine, lastLine, kind]; a code fence or a run of bullets with one kind can be one range. Kinds: a mental model + canonical forms (incl. canonical examples), b option/API reference, c trap warning, d migration/version, e non-core subpath, f testing, n navigation/index. Line numbers are of the files at commit ff281f3c. tools/audit.mjs then moves single sentences of a paragraph to c, d or e where their text says so (the sentence-refined column).
